title: "Theming"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: '#>'
---

{basecoat} ships with a handful of great themes out of the box.
The built in styles are found in the `bc_styles` object.

```{r}
bc_styles
```

Basecoat uses a hadful of specific tailwind css utility classes to drive the theme itself.

The R package ships with a [theme builder](/theme/index.html) available online or via `basecoat::bc_theme_builder()`.

Alternatively, any theme created at [tweakcn](https://tweakcn.com/) will work wodnerfully.
